origin: Owned declarative selected-rank vectors, Python stdlib only; no production codec or permutation code imported.
method: Place selected items at their target rank coordinates, then fill remaining ranks with original unselected items. One-slot motion uses existence of an unselected sibling above/below.
scope: Exhaustive five-layer sibling subsets with and without an anchored Background. Not a Photoshop-produced file or independent Photoshop pixel comparison.
